sourceReview.method: Verified 10-operation HMX queue packets (HMX_Q2_BATCH10_OPERATIONS = 10, HMX_Q2_BATCH10_COMMAND_BYTES = 4504 in an 8192-byte command header, n_tensors = 30, n_ops = 10, 4 queue writes per 40-block projection, 11,886,592-byte streaming mapping, 36,954,112-byte 1-projection resident mapping, and 62,021,632-byte 2-projection resident mapping within the 64 MiB cap), bounded 15-millisecond spin-polling in Session::read before 1 ms OS timer sleep fallback on queue_read 516 (AEE_EWOULDBLOCK), RowParallelism::update_rows in-place worker partitioning, and 64-row L1-tiled branchless 8-plane integer dot reconstruction in HmxQ2Executor::accumulate_batch<B>.
sourceReview.scope: Batch-ten HMX queue submission, bounded queue-read spin-polling, and 4-worker L1-tiled 8-plane dot reconstruction in hexagon-native-rpc, bonsai-hexagon-runtime, prism-hexagon-model-probe, and bonsai-tools model_device supervisor within the 64 MiB native arena and 24,000-operation session cap.

diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.power: Outer workload clock and all build/control steps observed battery operation (acConnected: false, batterySaver: false, 89% battery charge) throughout the 43.364-second run (within the 540-second predeclared allowance). All four arm endpoints in both device controls observed battery (acConnected: false), battery saver off, and 89% charge. Equal endpoints cannot prove uninterrupted stability; do not combine this battery session with prior AC-connected sessions for cross-session performance comparisons.
diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.interpretation: Increasing packet batch size from 4 to 10 K=128 operations per queue packet (4 queue writes per projection instead of 10) and adding bounded 15 ms spin-polling in Session::read reduced nativeSubmitAndWaitMilliseconds to 22.21-23.48 ms for 1 projection (12 total queue writes across 3 tokens) and 44.08-46.26 ms for 2 projections (24 total queue writes across 3 tokens, ~5.5-5.8 ms per 10-op packet). Parallelizing 8-plane dot reconstruction across all 4 row workers with 64-row L1 tiling (RowParallelism::update_rows + accumulate_batch<10>) kept total 2-projection native evaluation (513.61-537.70 ms) within 11-50 ms of 1-projection native evaluation (487.91-529.85 ms) despite an extra +22.5 ms of DSP submit-and-wait time. However, because the signed ggml-htp DSP binary executes each K=128/N=8 OP_MUL_MAT operation independently and writes 8 separate FP32 bitplane vectors (557,056 bytes per op = 5.57 MB per batch10 packet) back to shared memory, each projection still incurs ~22.2-23.5 ms of DSP round-trip time plus ~10-15 ms of host-side plane reconstruction and superblock scale application, whereas 4-worker NEON CPU completes a single projection in ~2-3 ms.

defaultBlockers: The published CPU Prism runtime and server have no NPU serving integration. Changing the descriptive admission lock alone cannot enable offload.
The experimental session is terminal, at most 120 seconds, 64 MiB mapped shared buffer (at most 2 resident 25.07 MB FFN projections), and 24,000 logical operation attempts.

No matched end-to-end latency, energy or capacity benefit has been established. Even at 10 operations per queue packet (4 queue writes per projection), DSP execution and 8-plane FP32 shared-memory writeback take ~22.2-23.5 ms per projection (~44.1-46.3 ms for 2 projections).
Broader arithmetic/history, native ownership/lifecycle, persistent recovery, packaging/isolation and release acceptance remain incomplete.
nextConcreteImplementation: Evaluate whether full-projection K=5120 (or multi-block K>128) weight tiling and DSP-side plane/scale reduction are supported by any signed Hexagon package symbol or solver parameter so a projection avoids 40 separate K=128/N=8 OP_MUL_MAT dispatches and 22.28 MB of FP32 bitplane shared-memory traffic per projection before expanding resident arena capacity or attempting performance qualification.
